likely_enjoyment_signals.uncertainty_rule: Do not claim the candidate will enjoy a role when the posting provides insufficient evidence about the actual day-to-day work. Return Uncertain instead.

gap_policy.principle: A gap is not automatically disqualifying.
evaluate_gap_by: How central the requirement is to the role
Whether the skill is realistically learnable
Whether adjacent experience provides a credible bridge
Whether the employer describes it as required or preferred
Whether the gap would prevent successful performance from the start
gap_policy.important_ai_boundary: Do not convert general technology leadership or recent AI-assisted workflow experience into unsupported claims of deep machine learning engineering, model development, data science, or long-term enterprise AI leadership.

compensation_policy.unknown_compensation: Unknown compensation should trigger investigation, not rejection.
